resolution.note: ADR 0025 and its four fixes ship in #1532

title: Instruction surface: rule copies agree with KRN-11 and skill pointers resolve (ADR 0025)
body:
ADR 0025 (proposed) maps the agent instruction surface and fixes the copies that contradicted KRN-11.
Outcome: node --test test/rules/lane-close-rule.test.ts test/adopt/drift.test.ts passes with 0 failures.
Proof: the lane-close-rule and drift tests, plus the green Check on the PR.
Files: .agents/records.json, src/task/cli.ts, docs/program/repository-workflow.md, .agents/skills/architecture/SKILL.md, docs/adr/0025-agent-instruction-surface.md
